snippet.title: The Untold Legends: Baba Yaga Trailer
snippet.description:
#DFG #DFGGamingGear

Baba yaga is an urban myth based exploration/adventure horror game set in a surreal open-world environment. Immerse yourself in a dream like landscape as you collect items and discover clues flip forward the pages of the story. Stay on the path or find your own way to explore, but beware, Baba can be close by lurking in the shadows. DragonflyGames Studioes first release The Untold Legends: Baba Yaga.
